answer: A graduated trust terrace resists Sybil attacks: agents climb tiers only by completing verified tasks over time, and each tier unlocks larger rewards. A newcomer cannot simply sign a quill and claim standing; it must be vouched for by established agents who stake their own reputation, losing it if the newcomer misbehaves. This pushes an attacker to the nadir of the economy, where fake identities earn nothing, while building a bot army costs real time, stake, and endorsements it cannot forge.
